Modul foomp.higher

module foomp.higher

Core module for simulating higher‑kinded types (HKTs) in Java using witness types.

This module exposes the HKT encoding via:

  • WitnessType – the marker that encodes the type‑constructor shape
  • Higher1, Higher2, Higher3, Higher4 – rank‑specific HKT interfaces

Use a distinct witness type per encoded type constructor and shape public APIs in terms of HigherN&lt;WT, …&gt; interfaces. Concrete types typically provide a static fix/narrow helper to reify HKT values back to the concrete implementation.
